> Eod · 2026-09-16

Source: `C:\TAG Marketing Claude\Summit Plumbing Pros\EOD Report 2026-09-16.txt`

Wednesday. Two reports: Pipeliners plan steps 6 to 8 went live; Summit AZ got a read-only SEO/AEO/GEO review and a 2026 plan.

# Pipeliners
File: `Pipeliners\EOD Report 2026-09-16.txt`. See [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub).
- Step 7: new titles, metas and social titles on Fort McDowell, Maricopa and Litchfield Park (page 1, 0 clicks). Florence kept its title.
- Step 6 (Buckeye test): added a 217-word "Pipe Break Repair in Buckeye" section and an 8th FAQ to win back "buckeye pipe break repair". Next check 9/30.
- Tracking: rank tracker now also checks the 50 keywords from Phoenix, AZ; 11 city keywords added for step 8. OTTO recrawl run (autopilot off), no changes to the 122 URLs.
- Step 8: research showed Fountain Hills (#12) and Gilbert (#17) near page 1, Tempe and Mesa further back. With Kim's OK, one focus keyword per page aligned across title, H1, meta, body and a new 180 to 220 word answer-first section on Tempe, Mesa, Gilbert and Fountain Hills, plus 7 new links from neighbouring city pages. Mesa FAQ heading fixed (OTTO was overwriting it).
- Website pages tracker upgraded: publish dates, sorting, resizable columns, every cell editable with auto-save and change log.
- Fall Sewer Line Maintenance post confirmed indexed. Search Plan steps 4 to 7 done.

# Summit Plumbing Pros AZ
File: `Summit Plumbing Pros\EOD Report 2026-09-16.txt`. See [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- New [Search Atlas](lib:brain-search-atlas) crawl: 216 pages, 188 indexable, site score 929 to 931, technical health 93/100.
- Google: 42 clicks in 30 days, average position 24, 218 terms in positions 4 to 20. AI answers: 0 of 10 tracked general plumbing questions.
- Issues: About page has hidden Utah business info; 3 different sets of hours; pages not built for AI quoting; near-duplicate city pages (Gilbert vs Chandler drain cleaning 70% same); "(Lic. #)" with no number; unapproved "guaranteed" wording on 3 pages; authority score 9/100.
- 2026 plan: Phase A (to 10/2) fix business info, hours and claims; Phase B page improvements; Phase C directories, YouTube, local mentions. No live changes.

# Follow-ups
- Pipeliners: tree roots post link (Elementor); request indexing for /tempe/, /mesa/, /gilbert/, /fountain-hills/; Scott on GBP services, leak detection, /pipeline-locating/, warranty lines; Kim's OK on https GBP link, hidden links, OTTO lock.
- Summit: start Phase A; need real hours, "guaranteed" decision and a named licensed blog author; approval for schema and About page changes; replace the "24 hour emergency plumber" tracked question.
